reza-sales: Heads up 1: VeloxHealth execs escalated. Two blockers from CIO/CISO: (A) they require a VPC/private path for PHI with per-request audit logs; (B) they want a signed pen-test report and SOC2 timeline before contract signature. They also pushed back on list pricing, asking for a firm concession for a 24mo commit.
mona-se: Received their long prompt trace. Our hosted demo shows token soak but occasional KV lock contention at ~9k tokens/s. Repro steps and tiny log attached below.
carlos-eng: paste of log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-05T09:03:12Z] worker-7 INFO request id=ac3b kv_lock_wait=78ms
[2026-03-05T09:03:13Z] worker-7 WARN kvcache eviction triggered shard=10 free=120MB
[2026-03-05T09:03:14Z] worker-7 INFO throughput=9200 tokens/s seq=4096
```
mona-se: With their prompt mix the hotspot is prefix cache pressure. We can mitigate by larger kv shard allocation and prefix-only caching.
carlos-eng: Quick mitigation: deploy a dedicated private demo in eu-central with pool=6 and kv-shards=24, quantized model q5b. Command: 
```
redwood deploy --env velox-demo --region eu-central --pool-size 6 --kv-shards 24 --model q5b/redwood-opt
```
deploy-bot: deployment velox-demo requested by carlos-eng at 2026-03-05T09:15:03Z 1. Job id 9f8b.
carlos-eng: Running a 4h soak now. Will post results.
lina-gtm: On pricing, Velox is pushing for a 25% off list for 24mo with annual true-up. That's above our normal band. What flexibility do we have?
amy-legal: 25% requires exec approval and strong guardrails. Suggest counter: 18% off list with 6mo non-refundable minimum and backstop usage floor. Drafting clause for encryption-in-transit, EU processing, and audit log retention 7 years.
owen-cto: Ops comment: VPC/private path is doable but implies either Dedicated tenancy or Private control plane + customer VPC peering. Both add infra surcharge and operational onboarding (est. 6-8 weeks). Callout that pen-test requirement is reasonable; we can provide our latest pen-test report but a customer-specific pen-test will need an addendum.
mona-se: First soak summary (1h): sustained 11.2k tokens/s, p50=22ms, p95=140ms, kvcache miss=2.9%. No OOMs. Will upload full artifacts.
carlos-eng: Upload -> https://redwood-internal/soaks/velox/1779999991/artifacts.zip
lina-gtm: I'll create an exec one-pager highlighting tradeoffs: (1) pricing band suggestion 16-20% with a staged true-up, (2) VPC surcharge estimate, (3) pen-test path. Need exact ops surcharge figure.
owen-cto: Ops surcharge estimate: one-time onboarding fee €25k + monthly dedicated ops fee €8k for exclusive tenancy in eu-central. Add SOC2 accelerated review fee if they want fast-tracked.
am y-legal: (typo fixed) amy-legal: Also adding indemnity language around customer pen-test and a requirement to coordinate windows.
reza-sales: Action list and owners: 
- carlos-eng: confirm soak + post perf report (ETA 2h)
- mona-se: create reproducible repro gist and tuning knobs used (ETA 1h)
- amy-legal: draft contract redline with pen-test coordination and audit log clause (ETA EOD)
- owen-cto: finalize ops surcharge and timeline for VPC/private path (ETA EOD)
- lina-gtm: one-pager and proposed pricing band + term summary (ETA EOD)

lina-gtm: If we need to grant >20% we should ask for a revenue commit and multi-year non-cancellable terms. Any objections?
amy-legal: No objections if we get a non-refundable minimum and usage floor; will write that in.
mona-se: small nit: repro will include the exact redwood cli invocation + env vars; example below: 
```
REDWOOD_ENV=velox-demo REDWOOD_POOL=6 REDWOOD_KV_SHARDS=24 redwood run --seq-len 4096 --continuous-batching=false
```
reza-sales: I'll prep an internal exec summary to send to CS and the AE. If we can land the one-pager and legal terms today we can lock a signing call early next week. :rocket:
deploy-bot: reminder: presales triage call for VeloxHealth scheduled at 2026-03-05T11:00:00Z -> https://meet.redwood/velox-presales-15m
reza-sales: thanks all, will ping if Velox CISO follows up with specific pen-test scope.
